cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the top of a restored ancient city wall — kneeling on the ground; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — standing; the grand staircase of an old castle — standing; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing; a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; a starship galley and mess hall — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a night observatory under an open dome — looks into a small brass telescope; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — standing; an old stone chapel lit by candles — standing
